title: Same Model. One Is 4x Smaller.
description:
Two files. Same architecture, same job. One stores its weights as decimals, the other as whole numbers.

13.96 MB becomes 3.66 MB. File size is only one part of the trade-off.

Full measured comparison: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QB7cgfILOVI&t=3s

#EdgeAI #Quantization #MachineLearning #OnDeviceAI
